meta.note: A new brand, 9 Nov 2026. No platform code exists yet: these values are the starting point the platform's own stylesheet will copy. Tutors' sites use their own 10 layouts and 10 colour sets, not these.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The page. Exercise-book white with a little green in it by day; a green-black at night. Never pure white, never pure black.

tokens.name: sheet
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces on paper: cards, fields, dialogs, the price card.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text and the wordmark, on paper, sheet and pen-wash (15.6:1 on paper by day, 16:1 at night).

tokens.name: pencil
tokens.usage: Second text: dates, meta lines, captions, on paper, sheet and pen-wash (5.4:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Ruled lines, hairlines between rows, a card's top rule. Decoration only: it never carries meaning alone, and never edges a control (that is edge).

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: The edge of a field, a choice chip and a second button, so a control can be found without reading its label: 3.3:1 or more on paper and sheet in both themes.

tokens.name: margin
tokens.usage: The red margin line of an exercise book: a 1px vertical hairline at the left of a ruled page. Never text, never a fill.

tokens.name: pen
tokens.usage: The one accent: the green pen teachers correct with. The primary button, links (underlined in running text), the chosen state's text and edge, the teacher's tick, margin notes and the correction. As text on paper, sheet and pen-wash (5.5:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: pen-deep
tokens.usage: The primary button and links under the pointer or pressed.

tokens.name: on-pen
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on a pen fill: the primary button's label (6.5:1 by day, 10:1 at night).

tokens.name: pen-wash
tokens.usage: Chosen: the picked look in the look picker, the current step in sign-up. A tint only ever means chosen.

tokens.name: tile
tokens.usage: The logo's green tile and the seal's disc. The same in both themes, like a printed mark.

tokens.name: on-tile
tokens.usage: The e on the tile and the seal's words.

tokens.name: marker
tokens.usage: Highlighter yellow: the hat on the tile, and one stroke behind the one word that matters on a screen. Never text.

tokens.name: on-marker
tokens.usage: Text over the highlighter stroke, in both themes (13:1 by day, 12:1 at night).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: A payment that failed, a field that can't be saved. As text on paper, sheet and danger-wash, always with words that say what went wrong.

tokens.name: danger-wash
tokens.usage: Behind a danger note.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Needs the tutor soon: a card about to expire, a lesson not yet paid. As text on paper, sheet and warn-wash.

tokens.name: warn-wash
tokens.usage: Behind a warn note.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The keyboard focus ring: 3px solid, 2px outside the control. An alias of pen, 5.5:1 or more on paper and sheet in both themes.

tokens.name: select
tokens.usage: Selected text: the highlighter, see-through.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Brygada 1918, a book face revived from a 1918 Polish type: it draws Latin, Cyrillic, Greek and Vietnamese. Headings and the name only. Loaded from Google Fonts.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The one headline on the platform's home page. On a phone, 44px.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page titles on the marketing site, and the price.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Titles in sign-up and the tutor dashboard.

styles.name: heading
styles.sample: Students book and pay on your site

styles.name: milestone
styles.usage: The first line of a milestone message, and an email's subject inside the email.

styles.name: note
styles.usage: Margin notes and the words added over an insert mark, in pen.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Commissioner, a humanist sans with Latin, Cyrillic, Greek and Vietnamese. Everything you read in a row or click. Tabular figures for prices, times and dates.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: A site in your name, with booking and payments built in.
styles.usage: The paragraph under a page title.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Students pick a time, pay by card and get a calendar invite.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, field labels in forms, tab names.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Dates, prices and other quiet facts beside a row's title, in pencil.

styles.name: legend
styles.usage: Small capitals over a value (set uppercase). In pencil, on one row beside its value and action.

styles.name: colophon
styles.usage: The one line Chapeau puts on a tutor's site, in the footer's own quiet colour, never in these colours.

spacing.note: A 4px base. Space separates things; it never fills a gap.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a legend and its value; inside a chip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between an icon and its words; between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between rows inside a card; a field's inner side padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone gutter; a card's inner padding on a phone; between cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: A card's inner padding on a laptop; between a heading and what it heads.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Laptop gutter; between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between the big sections of the marketing site.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Above and below the home page's headline.

tokens.name: rule-pitch
tokens.usage: The distance between ruled lines on a ruled page.

radius.note: Paper is cut, not moulded: small corners. The logo's tile is the one round shape, 22% of its side.

tokens.name: r-xs
tokens.usage: The highlighter stroke and text lit by select.

tokens.name: r-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields and choice chips.

tokens.name: r-md
tokens.usage: Cards, the price card, the look picker's swatches.

tokens.name: r-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and sheets on a phone.

tokens.name: r-tile
tokens.usage: The logo tile and any app icon: 112 on a 512 grid.

tokens.name: r-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills only: Paid, Due, Card declined.

shadow.note: Paper on a desk: one tight shadow, no glow.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards at rest on paper.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: A milestone message, a dialog, a menu: things that sit over the page.

easing.note: One move has character: the hat tip. Everything else is plain.

tokens.name: ease-tip
tokens.usage: The hat tip: the hat lifts and turns with a small overshoot, then settles.

tokens.name: ease-plain
tokens.usage: Everything else that moves: a dialog opening, a step changing.

duration.note: Short. Reduced motion makes all of it instant.

tokens.name: dur-tip
tokens.usage: The hat tip, up and back.

tokens.name: dur-step
tokens.usage: A sign-up step sliding in, a dialog fading up.

tokens.name: dur-shade
tokens.usage: A control changing shade under the pointer.
